notes.title: Arcade Paradise VR Free Content Update
notes.notes:
Hey Retro heads!

We have dropped a new content update to Arcade Paradise VR. Bringing you two brand-new cabinets to PC VR and it is also launching PCVR & Meta Quest today!

Cyber Drums: Got rhythm? Take your musical skills to the next level in this electrifying drumming experience. Rock your way to infamy as you pound out beats that make the crowd go wild!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077488/461588e980a6ba17977b6846817d2686d80806f3.jpg

Super Woodgal JR Ultra Ex Hyper-Deluxe: Everyone’s favourite lumber-jill is back in glorious 3D! Swing your mighty axe, whack the tree in style, and show the world your unparalleled wood-chopping prowess.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077488/b6b847238619c573868a32dbc71009862a4c97a6.jpg

Watch the latest trailer here:
[previewyoutube=UZcG3XTG5FM;full][/previewyoutube]

You can save 30% off Arcade Paradise VR on Steam until 6PM GMT December the 4th.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676160/Arcade_Paradise_VR/

notes.title: Arcade Paradise VR | New Game Update and PICO Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello Arcade Fans! 

We are thrilled to announce that on December 3rd we will be launching a brand-new and FREE content update for Arcade Paradise VR. This content update features TWO fully interactive and VR exclusive games that will join the 40+ line-up of cabinets already available. 

About the New Games featured in the Content Update

- Cyber Drums: Got rhythm? Take your musical skills to the next level in this electrifying drumming experience. Rock your way to infamy as you pound out beats that make the crowd go wild! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077488/d8da2796a7b459aeab1f8f1dae2037a4f3d84a47.jpg

- Super Woodgal JR Ultra Ex Hyper-Deluxe: Everyone’s favourite lumber-jill is back in glorious 3D! Swing your mighty axe, whack the tree in style, and show the world your unparalleled wood-chopping prowess. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077488/abf89282d949fa7809f8d64201aeee03d45852d3.jpg

Get a sneak peek of the cabinets in action in our announcement trailer
[previewyoutube=Hr35bWHfYH4;full][/previewyoutube]

The next free content update for Arcade Paradise VR featuring Cyber Drums and Super Woodgal JR Ultra EX Hyper-Deluxe will be launching on December 3rd!  

But thats not all!

On November the 28th, we welcome a new member to the Arcade Paradise VR family.

Manage profits, pick up gum, do the laundry and earn coin to unlock arcade units and flip the family laundromat business on the PICO 4.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2676160/Arcade_Paradise_VR/

notes.title: Latest Arcade Paradise VR Patch
notes.notes:
Hey Laundry fans!

The New Arcade Paradise VR patch should now be live.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077488/ad25b3ca5b8d632aae10808ecc5cb13360b2484e.jpg


 Fix for blockers in the empty scene mid-way through the game. Existing save data should be fixed automatically
 Added an optional Stylus in the Misc menu in the PDA
 Hand Lasers are turned off when in the PDA now
 Fix for disappearing machines in some arcade layouts
 Fix for occasional crash in Barkanoid
 Fix for rare issue at end of first extension when you'd stop receiving chat messages and not be able to progress. Existing saves will be progressable now


Enter the virtual realm in Arcade Paradise VR, transporting you back to 1993 for an all-new immersive experience oozing with retro-fuelled gaming nostalgia. Taking you on an empowering journey from rags to riches, Arcade Paradise is an adventure and light-management sim combo game where you transform the decrepit King Wash laundromat into a thriving business.
